name: A Biological Process Bigraph
description: Fig 1c — A biological process bigraph: processes are wired into the store hierarchy, each assigned a specific mechanism declared in its contract. Transcription reads the DNA template to make mRNA; translation reads mRNA at the ribosome to make protein; metabolism runs the enzyme-catalysed reaction network. The place graph (nesting) and the process coupling (wires) together are the bigraph.
